sentences.text: Boston University -LRB- commonly referred to as BU -RRB- is a private research university located in Boston , Massachusetts .	Boston	Boston	Massachusetts	Massachusetts	private	Private university
The university is nonsectarian , and is historically affiliated with the United Methodist Church .	nonsectarian	nonsectarian	United Methodist Church	United Methodist Church
The university has more than 3,900 faculty members and nearly 33,000 students , and is one of Boston 's largest employers .	Boston	Boston
It offers bachelor 's degrees , master 's degrees , and doctorates , and medical , dental , business , and law degrees through 17 schools and colleges on two urban campuses .

The main campus is situated along the Charles River in Boston 's Fenway-Kenmore and Allston neighborhoods , while the Boston University Medical Campus is in Boston 's South End neighborhood . BU is a member of the Boston Consortium for Higher Education and the Association of American Universities .	Boston	Boston	Association of American Universities	Association of American Universities

The University was ranked 39th among undergraduate programs at national universities , and 32nd among global universities by U.S. News & World Report in its 2017 rankings .	U.S. News & World Report	U.S. News & World Report

Among its alumni and current or past faculty , the university counts eight Nobel Laureates , 23 Pulitzer Prize winners , 10 Rhodes Scholars , six Marshall Scholars , 48 Sloan Fellows , nine Academy Award winners , and several Emmy and Tony Award winners .
